capabilities: Run Socratic, Devil's Advocate, and Feynman checks
Track review dates in an Incubator panel
Generate gate questions with optional AI
Recall earlier answers via spaced review
extras: Pre-release (v0.9.0), not yet in Community Plugins (manual install); tested only on Windows 11 desktop, not mobile. AI is off by default and makes no network requests when off; with AI on, an API key is stored as plain text in data.json and syncs with the vault. Companion Chrome extension (Seedbed Capture) and Agent Skill (seedbed-skill) are separate repositories. Feynman checks are pattern matching, not understanding, so false positives are expected.
problem: Ideas get captured but never developed or critically tested, so they sit unexamined and eventually get forgotten.
